slides.text: the slime is not a punishment.
nobody on this channel ever won a car.
they won a mountain bike, a boombox,
and a story they still tell at work.
nobody here is going to skip the obstacle course.
you will watch all eight obstacles.
a viewer writes: "is the slime edible?"
we have been told this many, many times.
on this channel the grown-ups hold the clipboards
and the kids run the place.
every host on this channel is having
the best day of his life.
we don't know how. we're not asking.
these days you play the game on your phone.
and then it dumps a bucket on you.
somebody gets a pie in the face in the next half hour.
we can say it's almost never the host.
we have the tape where they lose it all.
we have the one where they win it all.
we play them in no particular order.
every bonus round on this channel has a clock.
you'd be amazed what a kid can do
with sixty seconds and a giant nose.
there's a show on this channel where a giant talking stone head
tells kids how to get through his temple.
he has never once come down off the wall to help.
on GUTS, kids raced up a mountain called the aggro crag.
it lit up. it smoked. it was foam.
the winner took home a piece of it.
every kid in america wanted that rock.
on one of our shows, kids chase a thief named carmen sandiego.
and an a cappella group does it.
nick arcade put kids inside a video game.
it was a blue screen and a lot of pointing.
one of our double dare tapes was recorded on new year's eve, 1986,
somebody spent the last night of the year
watching kids get hit with pies.
fun house stopped the game show in the middle
nobody ever explained why. nobody needed to.
every temple, mountain and giant nose on this channel
is made of foam, painted to look like stone.
you could have done better than that kid.
you never sent in the postcard.
if you are watching this at home on a couch,
please do not attempt the physical challenge.
somewhere on this channel a kid is about to reach
he does not know what is up there.
the two kids on the red team met this morning.
by the bonus round they would die for each other.
nobody on this channel has ever been told to calm down.
a viewer writes: "how do i get on one of these shows?"
you had to be a kid, around 1992,
every contestant on this channel got a helmet,
we've had thirty years to think about it.
kids at home: yell the answer at the tv.
they couldn't hear you in 1991 either.
on this channel you can lose
and still go home with the t-shirt.
we went home with the t-shirt.
the host will now explain the rules.
nobody's listening. somebody just fell in the pool.
on figure it out, a panel of nickelodeon stars
tries to guess a kid's secret talent.
do the secret slime action and you get slimed.
it can be as small as touching your hair.
the panel touches its hair a lot.
on one of our tapes, wild and crazy kids
takes a crowd of kids to a water park
the lifeguards are pretending this is normal.
video power had a host called johnny arcade.
his job was to talk about video games
on splatalot, kids try to storm a castle
past defenders whose whole job is stopping them
with slime, balls and a moat.
the defenders are very good at their jobs.
family double dare let the parents play.
the parents got just as messy as the kids.
the kids had been waiting years for this.
super sloppy double dare was double dare, but sloppier.
they put it right in the name.
nobody can say they were not warned.
